releaseNotes: v1.8.0: Heat control reworked for IntelliCenter 3.x. Heat source is now set the same way the Home Assistant integration does it, which fixes heaters that couldn't be turned on from Hubitat on newer firmware. Pool and Spa devices show the heat choices your panel offers in heatSources, using your heater names. heaterMode now shows Heating, Idle or Off, so check any rules or dashboards that use it. Old heat source names still work. Supported firmware: 1.064 and later, including 3.x; the withdrawn 2.x line isn't supported. Thanks to CuriousB for testing. No Done needed. v1.7.2: Tidier main page banner. Spacing and size now match Hubitat's built-in apps, and it stacks cleanly on a phone. Same change as Reolink 1.6.17, thanks to gopher.ny. No Done needed. v1.7.1: Gentler on the hub after a reboot. The Bridge now waits 3 minutes after the hub starts before connecting, so the controller's live updates don't arrive while the hub is still starting up (one could be dropped with a "Too many events pending" error). Done, Initialize and Refresh still connect right away once the hub has been up 5 minutes. Also skips building the Full-only message log when Full logging is off. No Done needed. v1.7.0: Choose which equipment Hubitat creates (Equipment page; deleted devices stay deleted). One Log level in the app for every device, with all logs under the app. Dark mode. Reconnects on its own if the controller goes quiet, and devices only change when a command was actually sent. Pump shows the running body's water temperature. Body devices get plain command names (old ones still work), and Heat Lock now covers every heat change. Salt cells reported by the controller get their own Chlorinator device. No Done needed: the Bridge switches over on its own within a minute.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Pentair IntelliCenter
apps.description: Connects to the IntelliCenter controller and lets you choose which equipment Hubitat creates.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Bridge
drivers.description: Internal: holds the connection to the controller and creates the equipment devices. Created by the app.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Body
drivers.description: Pool or spa: on/off, water temperature, set point, heat source (from your panel's heaters) and Heat Lock.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Pump
drivers.description: Variable speed pump: RPM, GPM and watts, plus speed control.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Chlorinator
drivers.description: IntelliChlor salt cell: salt level, pool and spa output and superchlorinate (read-only).
